name: Kopia Backups
author: Steve Clarke
description: Shows whether Kopia's scheduled backups are healthy, running, failed or overdue, with a seven-day heatmap and failure alerts.

barWidget.description: Backup health, next run, heatmap and failure alerts for a Kopia snapshot timer.

schema.label: Bar text
schema.description: Shown beside the icon: nothing, time until the next backup, or the last backup time.

schema.label: Warn after (hours)
schema.description: Hours without a backup before the icon turns red.

schema.label: Source path
schema.description: The folder the backup covers. Blank means your home folder.

schema.label: Backup service
schema.description: The systemd user service that runs kopia snapshot create.

schema.label: Backup schedule
schema.description: The systemd user timer that starts the service.

schema.label: Show the Back up now button
Web UI address
schema.description: Blank hides the Open web UI button.

schema.label: Web UI username
schema.description: The --server-username of the Kopia web UI. Blank signs in by hand in the browser.

schema.label: Web UI password file
schema.description: A file holding KOPIA_SERVER_PASSWORD=..., read when the button is pressed. Only the path is saved.

schema.label: Notify when a backup is overdue
